sources.title: Oregon Electric Railway Company 1970 Annual Report
sources.note: Downloaded and text-extracted, with schedule images checked. Report covers March 1–December 31, 1970. Schedule 531 (printed p. 508; PDF p. 109) directly reports average mileage of road operated as 186, used as the nearest documented late-period comparison for the 1969 snapshot. Schedule 412 (printed p. 401; PDF p. 92): 122.70 main-line + 29.78 branch + 34.00 trackage-rights miles = 186.48 operated miles. Schedule 228 (printed p. 245; PDF p. 58): $2,530,000 issued stock; Schedule 218 (printed pp. 234–237): no funded debt. Schedule 200L (printed p. 201; PDF p. 14) confirms stock at beginning and end of reporting period. Schedule 108 (PDF p. 10) documents indirect BN control through SP&S effective March 2, 1970. No usable average-employee count found; Schedule 561C concerns prior-year compensation.
